sections.title: 简介
sections.goal: 让用户在安装前判断产品是否适用，并理解插件版/独立版差异、兼容范围与数据边界。
sections.goal_en: Help users decide whether the product fits before installing, and understand plug-in vs standalone, compatibility scope and data boundaries.

children.title: 产品概览
children.goal: 回答「这是什么、解决什么问题、值不值得用」。
children.goal_en: Answer what it is, which problem it solves, and whether it is worth using.

children.title: 能做什么、不能做什么
children.title_en: What it can and cannot do

children.title: 运行形态
children.goal: 帮助用户选择 Maya 插件版还是独立版/EXE。
children.goal_en: Help users choose between the Maya plug-in edition and the standalone edition / EXE.

children.title: 兼容性与数据
children.goal: 说明支持哪些 Maya 版本、渲染器，以及资产库数据存在哪里、如何备份。
children.goal_en: Explain which Maya versions and renderers are supported, where library data lives and how to back it up.

children.title: 渲染器与已装插件支持
资产库目录结构与数据安全

sections.title: 安装与授权
sections.goal: 安装、初始化、升级、卸载与授权。
sections.goal_en: Install, initialize, upgrade, uninstall and license the product.

children.title: 安装
children.goal: 在动手前确认环境与安装包无误，减少装到一半失败。
children.goal_en: Confirm the environment and the installer before starting, so installation does not fail halfway.

children.title: 系统与 Maya 版本要求
首次运行
children.goal: 让用户知道第一次启动会发生什么、从哪里打开、如何完成初始化。
children.goal_en: Show what happens on the first launch, where to open it from, and how to finish initialization.

children.title: 启动入口（工具栏 / 货架 / 菜单）
children.title_en: Launch entry points (shelf / status line / script)

children.title: 升级与卸载
children.goal: 升级不丢配置，卸载不留残留。
children.goal_en: Upgrade without losing settings; uninstall without leaving leftovers.

children.title: 授权
children.goal: 用户能自助完成激活、续期、换机与故障排查。
children.goal_en: Let users activate, renew, move machines and troubleshoot on their own.

sections.title: 入门
sections.goal: 让零基础用户在 10 分钟内看懂界面、掌握基本操作，并跑通一次「导入 → 整理 → 导入场景」。
sections.goal_en: Let a complete beginner understand the interface and basic operations within 10 minutes and run one full “import → organize → import into scene” loop.

children.title: 界面
children.goal: 让用户知道每个区域叫什么、负责什么。
children.goal_en: Show what each area is called and what it is responsible for.

children.title: 布局与面板
children.goal: 让用户把界面调整成自己顺手的样子，并知道怎么恢复。
children.goal_en: Let users shape the interface to their liking and know how to restore it.

children.title: 保存、恢复与重置布局
